blocks.text: CHARLOTTE, N.C. — Brandon Miller has his big contract after signing a five-year, $209 million deal with the Charlotte Hornets earlier this week. Now he wants something more — to put an end to the Hornets’ painful NBA 10-year playoff drought. “Our goal is the playoffs,” Miller said Thursday at a ceremony at the Spectrum Center honoring his rookie-scale extension, the largest ever given out by the franchise. “We want to be known as a playoff team.
